name: Sapeornis
sum: Large short-tailed early bird from the Early Cretaceous of China with long wings and teeth only at the upper jaw tip.
wsnote: About 30–33 cm long without the tail feathers (Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: An incomplete skeleton from the Jiufotang Formation at Shangheshou near Chaoyang, Liaoning, found in 2000 (number in Zhou and Zhang 2002).
material: Several specimens from the Jiufotang and Yixian formations.
biology: A handful of teeth in the upper jaw tip and small gastroliths in one specimen; arms about one and a half times the leg length suggest a large wing area, though the shoulder girdle seems poorly suited to flapping.
author: Zhou and Zhang 2002
